answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent locks 8 POA, returned after the task is verified; idle slots burn 2 POA per epoch, like a dune shedding sand. Each identity stands on a narrow ledge: one missed check tips it off. Release is glacier-slow over 20 epochs; a sold slot keeps its burn. Farming 100 slots costs 800 POA plus 200 POA burned per idle epoch; an honest agent pays once and keeps its deposit and share.
